Items & Equips Core VisuStella MZ - Guia Completo para LLMs
============================================================

PLUGIN: Items & Equips Core VisuStella MZ
TIPO: Core / Quality-of-Life
TIER: 1 (colocar abaixo de plugins de tier menor)
REQUER: RPG Maker MZ

SUMARIO
-------
Este plugin melhora as cenas de Item, Equipamento e Shop do RPG Maker MZ.
Features: categorias customizaveis, parametros alem dos limites do editor,
requisitos de equipamento, itens amaldicoados, precos dinamicos, visibilidade
condicional no shop, marcador NEW!, Shop Status Window detalhado.

ESTRUTURA DA DOCUMENTACAO
--------------------------

conceitos/
  visao-geral.md          - Introducao, features, requisitos, tier
  equipment-type-handling.md - Mecanica de slots por classe, Change Equip
  shop-status-window.md   - Shop Status Window melhorado, Modern Controls

notetags/
  gerais.md               - Max, Color, Category, Conserve, ID Sort Priority
  item-accessibility.md   - Enable/Disable Switch, JS Item Enable
  equipment.md            - Equip Slots, params, Copy Limit, Type Limit,
                            Artifacts, Class Only, Requirements, Added EType,
                            Cursed, Purify Transform, JS Parameters
  status-window.md        - Status Info, Custom Status Info, Status Style,
                            Custom Status Parameters, Shop Picture (completo)
  shop-menu.md            - Price, Can/Cannot Sell, Sell Price, Show/Hide
                            Shop Switch, Cannot Sell Switch, Buy/Sell Switches,
                            JS Buy/Sell Price
  referencia-rapida.md    - Tabela consolidada de TODAS as notetags

comandos/
  actor.md                - Change Equip Slots, Reset Equip Slots
  purify.md               - Purify Target Actor(s), Purify Whole Party
  shop.md                 - Shop: Advanced (ranges de IDs, blacklist/whitelist)

parametros/
  item-menu.md            - General Window, List Window, Item Quantity,
                            Shop Status Window, Button Assist
  item-categories.md      - Category List (types, icons, switches), Style
  new-labels.md           - NEW! Labels (icon, text, fade, offset)
  equip-menu.md           - General, Command Window, Remove Equip, Rulings,
                            Button Assist
  shop-menu.md            - General, Switches, Command Window, Prices,
                            Button Assist
  shop-status-window.md   - General, Equipment Data (Compare/Classic/Double),
                            Item Data, Vocabulary

referencia/
  compatibilidade.md      - Battle Core (damage vocab), Weapon Swap System
  extension-plugins.md    - 15 plugins de extensao (battle systems, equipment,
                            shop)

RELACAO ENTRE AREAS
--------------------
- conceitos/ e notetags/ estao ligados: cada mecanica tem notetags correspondentes
- notetags/equipment.md <-> comandos/actor.md e comandos/purify.md
- notetags/shop-menu.md <-> comandos/shop.md e parametros/shop-menu.md
- notetags/status-window.md <-> parametros/shop-status-window.md
- notetags/gerais.md (Category) <-> parametros/item-categories.md
- referencia/compatibilidade.md afeta uso de notetags/equipment.md (Cursed)

ORDEM DE LEITURA RECOMENDADA
------------------------------
1. conceitos/visao-geral.md (entender o plugin)
2. conceitos/equipment-type-handling.md (mecanica central)
3. notetags/referencia-rapida.md (referencia de todas as notetags)
4. notetags/ conforme necessidade por topico
5. comandos/ para acoes via eventos
6. parametros/ para configuracao de UI
7. referencia/ para compatibilidade
